svg.title: Figure 4-1 · Risk heat map (WP-M-07)
svg.desc: Probability by impact grid of the 29 WP-M-07 risks. Open: High 10 (R-01 E25, R-02 E20, R-06 E20, R-07 E20, R-26 E20, R-03 E16, R-04 E16, R-08 E15, R-09 E15, R-20 E15), Medium 17, Low 1; closed: R-05.
svg.text: 29 project risks of the §4 register on the probability × impact grid of §2.2; 28 open, 1 closed
No supplier evidence for the comma device / STM32H7
No HIL or on-device verification in the fork
ML insufficiencies cannot be quantified without training data
SR-A changes merged without independent review (16 change records in …
OEM ECU behaviour (EPS limiting and fault reaction, PCM, PCS availability) …
No external assessor engaged, or none affordable
Single-channel panda MCU sharing power, clock and board with the SoC
Funding for external assessor, pen test and HIL hardware not available
Open by band: High 10 · Medium 17 · Low 1 · closed 1 (R-05). Re-scored: R-10 P4 I4 E16 → P2 I4 E8, R-11 P3 I4 E12 → P2 I4 E8 (dotted chip = previous cell).
Scores are single-author engineering judgement (§2.2, OI-2). Label = the cause clause of the risk text, before the arrow. Treatment strategy = first word of the Treatment column.
